description: Repository interface for Product entity database operations in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: Repository interface extending JpaRepository for Product entity, providing custom query methods for product retrieval based on availability, category, and name.

methods.name: findByAvailableTrue
methods.description: Finds a paginated list of available products (where available attribute is true).

methods.name: findByCategory
methods.description: Finds a paginated list of products belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: findByNameContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds a paginated list of products whose name contains a specified string, case-insensitive.
